results.title: Resilience amid ruins: Why markets are hitting record highs despite the Iran war
Stock Market Outlook 2026: Political Risks Loom | Morgan Stanley
War Darkens Global Economic Outlook | IMF
10 Charts To Address Concerns On 2026 Geopolitical Conflict | Kitces

results.summary: Iran War dominant risk — Strait of Hormuz disruptions, oil near $94. Potential peace deal imminent (Iran delivering 14-point response May 7). US in Venezuela, NATO-Greenland tensions, EU-China EV/solar/semiconductor trade conflict. IMF base case: global growth 3.1%, inflation 4.4%. US equities, Japan, South Korea all at record highs despite conflict. Markets pricing in peace premium.
